Bug_Title: STI: Static Thread.interrupted() method invoked on thread instance (STI_INTERRUPTED_ON_UNKNOWNTHREAD)
Bug_Details:
This method invokes the Thread.interrupted() method on a Thread object that appears to be a Thread object that is
not the current thread. As the interrupted() method is static, the interrupted method will be called on a different
object than the one the author intended.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded by calling the static Thread.interrupted() method on the Thread class instead of the provided thread object. This can lead to incorrect results if the current thread is interrupted.
Trigger_Explanation: The bug is triggered in the test case 'testInterruptedBug' when the assertTrue method is called with the buggyClass.showBug(buggyThread) as the argument. This is because the showBug method incorrectly calls the static Thread.interrupted() method instead of the instance method buggyThread.isInterrupted().
